title: Let's Learn English Lesson 33
subtitle: Learning America's Sport

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 2
dialogue.en: It is time for part two of the children's show!
dialogue.zh: 兒童節目第二集的時間到了！

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 1
dialogue.en: It's time! It's time! I can't wait!
dialogue.zh: 到時間了！到時間了！我等不及了！

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 3
dialogue.en: Shh! I can't hear it!
dialogue.zh: 噓！我聽不見了！

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.en: Last time on "The Time Traveling Treehouse," Anna was lost, really lost. She wants to learn about baseball. But her computer, MINDY, sent her to many wrong places.
dialogue.zh: 上次在“時光旅行樹屋”裡，安娜迷路了，真的迷路了。她想了解棒球。可她的電腦 MINDY 把她送到了很多錯誤的地方。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: MINDY! Help me! I am in the ocean with a shark!
dialogue.zh: MINDY！幫幫我！我和一條鯊魚在海里！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: I will try one more time, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 我再試一次，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Please try harder, MINDY!
dialogue.zh: 請再努力一點，MINDY！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Now, where am I? I am at a playground with a baseball field! Yes! I can teach children about baseball here! MINDY, MINDY, it took you a long time. But you did it!
dialogue.zh: 現在，我在哪裡？我在一個有棒球場的操場！太好了！我可以在這兒教孩子們棒球！MINDY，MINDY，你花了很長時間。但你做到了！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Thanks, Anna. Give me a call when you find the answer.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，安娜。找到答案就給我打電話。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay. Come with me. Let's learn how to play baseball! This is a baseball field. This is a pitcher's mound. This is first base! This is second base! This is third base! This is home plate!
dialogue.zh: 好。跟我來。我們來學怎麼打棒球！這是棒球場。這是投手丘。這是一壘！這是二壘！這是三壘！這是本壘！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: To play baseball, you really only need a bat, a ball and a glove. Each team has many players.
dialogue.zh: 打棒球其實只需要球棒、球和手套。每支隊伍有很多球員。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Pitchers pitch the ball.
dialogue.zh: 投手投球。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Catchers catch the ball.
dialogue.zh: 捕手接球。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Batters bat the ball.
dialogue.zh: 擊球員擊球。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Runners run the bases.
dialogue.zh: 跑壘員跑壘。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Fielders field the ball.
dialogue.zh: 外野手接球。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: First, the pitcher pitches the ball to the batter. The batter bats the ball. Then, the runner runs to first base.
dialogue.zh: 首先，投手把球投給擊球員。擊球員擊球。然後，跑壘員跑向一壘。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Each time a batter bats, the runners run around the bases. Each time a runner runs across home plate, they score a run! There are nine innings in a game. The team with the most runs at the end of nine innings wins the game!
dialogue.zh: 每次擊球員擊球，跑壘員就繞著壘跑。每次跑壘員跑過本壘，他們就得一分！一場比賽有九局。九局結束時得分最多的隊贏！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: MINDY, MINDY, we found the answer! It's time to return to the treehouse.
dialogue.zh: MINDY，MINDY，我們找到答案了！該回樹屋了。

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Good job! That was fast.
dialogue.zh: 幹得好！真快。

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 3
dialogue.en: Good job Anna. You know, I still don't like children's shows, but I like this children's show.
dialogue.zh: 幹得好，安娜。你知道嗎，我還是不喜歡兒童節目，可我喜歡這個兒童節目。

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 2
dialogue.en: I liked the time travel.
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡時光旅行。

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 1
dialogue.en: But time travel is not real. You're so silly, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 可時光旅行不是真的。你真傻，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yeah, time travel is so silly. Thanks, goodbye. Bye, thank you.
dialogue.zh: 對，時光旅行很傻。謝謝，再見。再見，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, MINDY? Are you there?
dialogue.zh: 喂，MINDY？你在嗎？

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Hello, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 你好，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: MINDY, I want to go to China! Until next time ...
dialogue.zh: MINDY，我想去中國！下次見……

quiz.prompt: Where does MINDY finally send Anna?
choices: A playground with a baseball field

quiz.prompt: How many innings are in a baseball game?
Where does Anna want to go at the end?
